newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ANGLO STILL IN TALKS OVER JOHNNIC .
newsitem.headline: ANGLO STILL IN TALKS OVER JOHNNIC .

text.p: Further talks were scheduled on Wednesday morning between Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd and the National Empowerment Consortium (NEC), Anglo American said.
"There is another meeting scheduled for this morning," a company spokesperson said, declining to comment further.
According to a newspaper report on Wednesday, the long-awaited deal for the NEC to buy Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd's 48 percent stake in Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd had been finalised.
Business Day newspaper reported details of the deal could be unveiled later on Wednesday, quoting negotiating sources. It said neither side would confirm agreement had been reached.
The deal will be by far the largest black empowerment venture to date.
Johnnic -- whose assets include stakes in South African Breweries, Toyota South Africa, Premier Group and Times Media -- is due to announce its year-end results later on Wednesday.
